headings.leadersBlurb: These four are the automatic AFC seeds. Everyone else is chasing the three wild cards.
headings.pathsBlurb: Win the AFC South, or be one of the three best remaining clubs in the conference. The closer route is the one that matters.
headings.footer: Updated from ESPN’s public NFL feeds. Not affiliated with the NFL, the Houston Texans, or ESPN.
headings.footerTiny: Seven AFC teams qualify: four division winners and three wild cards. The playoff percentage is a season simulation from point differential and home field. It is not a betting line.
headings.conclusion: The Houston Texans have been mathematically eliminated from the NFL playoffs.
headings.injuryBlurb: Texans listed as injured or on injured reserve. A Tuesday practice note can move before Sunday.
headings.rootingBlurb: Who needs to lose for the division or the cut line to get closer. Not a betting line, and not a live in-game number.

narrative.headline: Two and a half games off the cut line
narrative.blurb: The Texans are 2-5 with a -5 point differential, two and a half games behind the last AFC playoff spot, and three games back of the Jaguars in the South. 10 games left, starting Sunday at the Chargers.

tiebreak.headToHead: Head-to-head inside the South: L 17–19 @ IND; W 26–3 @ TEN; W 34–31 @ JAX.
tiebreak.detail: If the South finishes level, the NFL starts with head-to-head, then division record, then common games, then conference record. Point differential is the eye test. It is not the first tiebreaker.
